release_name: PRIVATE EVENT PAYMENT FLOW + STATUS + EMAILS
description: Makes deposit, full-payment and balance payment use one reliable SumUp POST flow, records payment state in HQ and emails confirmations after successful payment.
changes: Deposit, pay-in-full and remaining-balance buttons now use the same POST payment route instead of direct GET navigation.
Successful private-event payments update inquiry and quote state through SumUp reconciliation/webhook handling.
Customer receives an automatic private-event payment confirmation email after a successful deposit, full payment or balance payment.
ADMIN_EMAIL receives a payment notification for successful private-event payments.
HQ Private Events now shows quote total, amount paid, remaining balance, latest payment state and SumUp checkout reference.
Existing v96.4.75 private-inquiry admin email and delete-test-inquiry controls are preserved.
notes: Homepage story sections restored; HQ dark sweep; iOS HQ drawer scroll fix; pre-live pending merch test cleanup.
desktop_layout_repair: MacBook/small desktop breakpoint repair; mobile below 768px preserved
name: HQ-REVENUE-VENUE-TEMPLATES-DARK-SWEEP
